text: The purpose of this report is to request authority to amend a non-competitive blanket contract 47022986 with Accuworx Incorporated (Accuworx), in the amount of $400,000.00 net of Harmonized Sales Tax ($407,040.00 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries). This contract amendment will ensure the continuity of essential hydraulic vacuum and pumping truck services required for Toronto Water's Wastewater collection and treatment systems and various other Toronto Water facilities. The services are required for the cleaning and disposal of waste by-products. These services are critical for response to spills and maintaining compliance with the Ministry of the Environment, Conservation and Parks. The non-competitive bridge contract will continue to honour the same pricing, terms and conditions as the previous contract # 47019412 awarded to Accuworx through a competitive solicitation Request for…

The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. In accordance with Section 71- 11.1c of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 71 (Financial Control), authorized the General Manager, Toronto Water to amend non-competitive blanket contract number 47022986 with Accuworx Incorporated for the non-exclusive services of a hydraulic vacuum and pumping truck contractor with driver/operators to clean the inside of incinerator induced draft fans, vacuum clean the hearths of ash and vacuum clean various tanks such as digester tanks, holding tanks and perform maintenance and emergency sewage removal works for Toronto Water, in the amount of $400,000 net of harmonized sales tax ($407,040 net of harmonized sales tax recoveries), increasing the current blanket contract value from $995,900 to $1,395,900, net of harmonized sales tax ($1,420,468 net of harmonized sales tax recoveries).
